Panel H quadrant percentages and panels I-J summary plots are directly displayed, but the precise gating denominator described as 'screened macrophages' is not further specified in the supplied pages.
Panel L bar values are visual estimates because numerical values are not printed; the ALB category also uses a broken y-axis.
The low CD163-positive percentage after αCD163/LNP-ZsGreen is an observed staining/flow-cytometry result only; the cited panels do not directly establish why CD163 detection decreased.
